timing_policy.timestamped_source: available_at equals the earliest independently verifiable official publication timestamp. A feature may enter a daily session only when available_at is no later than that session's configured cutoff.
timing_policy.date_only_source: When an official source exposes a publication date but no trustworthy time, the record is conservatively unavailable for that date and effective_session is the first later trading session.
timing_policy.non_trading_day_source: A publication on a non-trading day becomes effective on the first subsequent trading session.
timing_policy.after_cutoff_source: A publication after the configured daily cutoff becomes effective on the first subsequent trading session.
timing_policy.revision_policy: Original and revised observations are immutable separate versions. A later revision/restatement must never overwrite values previously visible to an earlier session.
timing_policy.surprise_policy: Surprise features require an expectation observation whose expectation_available_at is strictly earlier than the actual observation's available_at. Otherwise surprise_value is prohibited.
timing_policy.training_join_policy: Training or backtest joins must select the latest revision with available_at <= signal cutoff for that session. Economic period end/date alone is never a join key for information availability.
